title: Rotaract: Beyond Activities
summary: The Rotaract Club of DGMC was invited by the Rotaract Club of M. L. Dahanukar College of Commerce to attend a speaker meeting on 29 October 2026, featuring PDG Dr. Ulhas Kolhatkar of Rotary Club of Dombivli East, Districts 3140 and 3142.
description: The Rotaract Club of DGMC was invited by the Rotaract Club of M. L. Dahanukar College of Commerce to attend a speaker meeting on 29 October 2026, featuring PDG Dr. Ulhas Kolhatkar of Rotary Club of Dombivli East, Districts 3140 and 3142. The interactive Q&A session, titled “Rotaract: Beyond Activities,” explored the deeper purpose and impact of Rotaract. Dr. Kolhatkar addressed questions from the Rotaract President and Secretary, sharing insights on leadership, service and personal growth. The session encouraged members to look beyond routine activities and understand Rotaract as a platform for meaningful development.
location: M. L. Dahanukar College of Commerce, Mumbai, Maharashtra
